description: Reads what a webhook's mirror or test address really received, straight from that service: for each delivery the time, the HTTP method and the exact payload that was sent. Read-only, it changes nothing. Use it after a test delivery (that is wi_test_webhook) when the host wants to see the payload itself, or when a receiving system says it got nothing. It never touches the receiving system of the host. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers.
